info.name: Authored chain2 (Buffer A gradient -> Image tint)
info.description: Hand-authored OWN test export. No third-party shader. Buffer A writes a UV gradient; Image reads it on iChannel0 and tints it. A Common tab is shared; a Sound pass and a keyboard channel are present to exercise skip/warn.

renderpass.name: Common
renderpass.description: Shared helper used by both render tabs.
renderpass.code: vec3 tint(vec3 c) { return c * vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.25); }

renderpass.name: Buffer A
renderpass.description: Writes a horizontal/vertical UV gradient into its render target.

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.description: Reads Buffer A on iChannel0 and applies the Common tint.

renderpass.name: Sound
renderpass.description: Out-of-scope sound pass; must be skipped with a warning.
renderpass.code: vec2 mainSound(int samp, float time) { return vec2(0.0); }
